NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Wise Flooring Site Plan and Parking Deviation Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public meeting before the Planning Commission to consider the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 41 W. Ikea Way. The purpose of the request is to obtain approval of the Wise Flooring Site Plan and a Deviation From Strict Compliance For Parking. 

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on August 27, 2026, at 6:30 p.m. The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall.

NOTICE OF PUBLIC HEARING: Kimballs Station Site Plan and Preliminary Subdivision Plat Request

Notice is hereby given that Draper City will hold a public hearing before the Planning Commission to consider the above listed request. The property is located at approximately 600 E Kimballs Ln. The purpose of the request is to obtain approval for a site plan and preliminary subdivision plat for the Kimballs Station multi-family development. This Phase 1 section of the development will contain 20 townhome dwelling units and 146 condo dwelling units.

The hearing will be held at Draper City Hall in the City Council Chambers, on August 13, 2026 at 6:30 p.m.  The complete notice is posted on the Utah Public Notice Website; www.utah.gov/pmn/, Draper City Website; www.draperutah.gov/news/, and at Draper City Hall.
